label: LORD_3: causes the being of and governs all else and wills GOOD_4 to every other intellectual being
term: lord, typed by its grounds with recipient-directed willing (Lean `IsBenevolentLordByCauseAndGovernment`)
definition: IsBenevolentLordByCauseAndGovernment InAct GoodIn CausesIn esse Governs HasIntellect WillsGoodFor g: g is LORD_2 (definition c8e458bd: g causes the being of every other being in act as to being and governs every such being) and, for every other being x in act as to being that has intellect (DEF-HAS-INTELLECT), there is a respect r in which x is good (GoodIn x r) and g wills that good to x (WillsGoodFor g x r, recipient-directed willing, definition 08b826db, CREATURE_WILLING_1). The willing conjunct is separate from the governance conjunct: it is not typed that g governs x for, or toward, the good it wills to x. Example: on the unified Dei Filius root route with the restricted willing premise, the selected GOD_4 root (it causes the being of each other intellectual being and wills it its good in esse). Counterexample: a cause of the being of everything else that governs everything else but wills no good to an existing intellectual creature (DeiFiliusBenevolentLord Control.Controls part 4: such a being is LORD_2 and not LORD_3); a benevolent human ruler (governs, wills good to subjects, but does not cause their being). Distinguished from LORD_2 (no volitional conjunct) and LORD_1 (the primitive Primitives.IsLord, authority to dispose): LORD_3 types grounds proposed for authority, not authority itself, and contains no wisdom beyond having intellect, no justice and no jurisdiction to impose obligations.
note: Analyst reading, attribution deferred (#1733). Motivation, not attribution: the natural-law reply recorded in docs/notes/natural-goodness-function-and-authority.md to the objection that creation or power alone gives no rightful authority (ST I-II q.90 a.3 locates the making of law in one who has care of the community; not pinned or claimed here). Third sibling of LORD_1 (disambiguation aa1de96a); the only passage from it to LORD_1 is the open sense bridge 'Whatever is LORD_3 is LORD_1'. Structural properties: none built in; the restriction to intellectual recipients avoids the non-rational case on which the q.20 a.2 ad 3 ordered-love sibling (1dd68893) denies recipient-directed willing.
